messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "make sure all of the mixture is taken"
set: ["make sure all of the mixture is taken", "drink all of the mixture right away", "swallow all of the mixture right away", "drink the mixture slowly, over 5 to 10 minutes in all", "do not chew the mixture", "be sure caregivers know ahead of time", "use the mixture within 15 minutes", "first dose of the day is usually taken when first wake up", "this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective", "taken in the morning", "all of these conditions", "these can make your body absorb less of the medicine", "will not make the medicine less effective", "this can make the medicines less effective", "can be taken every day of the menstrual cycle", "taken 30 minutes before the start of single-day HEC"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
